svg.title: Groups run along the input dimension, so an outlier contaminates one group
svg.desc: W is d_out × d_in, stored row-major, so 128 consecutive input features in one row form a contiguous 64-byte read. Each cell here is one such group of 128 weights, and the ink is the group's largest absolute weight. A group carries 3 bytes of metadata against 64 bytes of payload: 4.7 percent overhead, or 4.19 bits per weight. The 4.0 outlier in group g3 of the first row sets that group's scale, so the other 127 entries round toward level 0. Isolating the outlier in its own group lets the remaining 127 resolve 0.1 to within 0.013.
svg.text: Each cell is a group of 128 consecutive input features in one row of W; the ink is the group's
largest |w|. Groups run along d_in so a group is a contiguous 64-byte read. A group carries 3 bytes
of metadata against 64 bytes of payload, 4.7 percent overhead. The 4.0 outlier in the first row's g3
sets that group's scale; the other 127 entries collapse toward level 0.
